purpose: Check the complete coarse-prefix, fine NQC, and ringdown waveform across Torch and JAX and measure its peak-anchored difference from a pinned public SEOBNRv4 binary.
comparisons: Torch/JAX complete complex mode on the same initial state, nominal equation choices, and full output chart
Each complete mode against the pinned public binary on common peak-anchored support, without fitting time, phase or amplitude
interpretation: The public comparison is descriptive; no new physical-accuracy threshold is inferred from these four cases. This does not settle published-source conventions, numerical convergence, NR accuracy, or independent ROM training.
